verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a company-operations SaaS platform could plausibly let users schedule recurring automations, but the evidence shows no user-facing way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The pack's recurring items are Firstbase staff filing annual reports and tax returns on the customer's behalf, plus automated sales-tax filings. These are vendor-managed services, an adjacent capability, not a user-configurable scheduler. The probes found no public API surface (no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt) to build one on.
